item.title: Hochul drubs Blakeman in Marist Poll as 33% of New Yorkers want to leave
item.description: According to the Marist Poll, Governor Kathy Hochul has reached her highest job approval rating in over four years, while most New Yorkers feel they can't afford the high cost of living and 33% of New Yorkers plan to move out of the state in five years.

item.title: Netflix declines to raise its offer to buy Warner, says deal is 'no longer financially attractive'
item.description: Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery’s studio and streaming business, in a stunning move that effectively puts Paramount in a position to take over the fellow storied Hollywood giant.
